m01-brown.observed_description: One solid matte chocolate-brown disc on a plain light background with a soft shadow, the same disc and framing as the 2.7 color discs.
m01-brown.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Reads as brown at 180 px.

m02-pink.observed_description: One solid matte rose-pink disc on a plain light background with a soft shadow, the same disc and framing as the 2.7 color discs.
m02-pink.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Clearly pink, not red or purple.

m03-purple.observed_description: One solid matte violet-purple disc on a plain light background with a soft shadow, the same disc and framing as the 2.7 color discs.
m03-purple.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Clearly purple, not blue or pink.

m04-gray.observed_description: One solid matte medium-dark gray disc on a plain light background with a soft shadow, the same disc and framing as the 2.7 color discs.
m04-gray.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Clearly darker than the background and lighter than the black disc.

m05-brown-dog.observed_description: One adult Labrador with a solid dark chocolate-brown coat sits on a light wooden floor in front of a white wall beside a window, looking at the camera. No collar; one dog, no people or objects.
m05-brown-dog.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the crop trims only the end of the tail. The coat is plainly brown.

m06-gray-cat.observed_description: One adult short-haired cat with a solid even gray coat sits on a wooden floor in front of a white wall under a window, looking at the camera. No collar; one cat, no people or objects.
m06-gray-cat.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop: the whole cat stays inside the crop. The coat is plainly gray.

m07-pink-bag.observed_description: The backpack photograph with the backpack in solid rose pink instead of yellow: one pink backpack stands upright on a light-grey floor in front of a light-grey wall. Nothing else changed.
m07-pink-bag.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Only the color differs from the 2.7 yellow bag.

m08-purple-chair.observed_description: The chair photograph with the chair painted solid violet purple instead of green: one purple wooden chair on a light wooden floor in front of a pale wall. Nothing else changed.
m08-purple-chair.note: Usable in 3:2 and in the centered 4:5 crop. Only the color differs from the 2.7 green chair.
